verdict.auditor_notes: The final report presents consistent statistical results (t-statistic -1.131, p=0.264, 95% CI -6.667 to 1.875) that align with standard calculations for an independent t-test. All sensitivity analyses (Welch's t-test, Mann-Whitney U test) are described with plausible p-values. The conclusion that the trial did not meet its primary endpoint is supported by the p-value exceeding 0.05. No implausible numbers, unsupported claims, or methodological inconsistencies are visible in the report itself.
